stated_limitation: significant for both sleep states in seven of them (permutation p < 0.05; the two exceptions were the sessions with the fewest HD cells)

justification.dataset: DANDI 000056 (Peyrache ADn/PoS) is the canonical head-direction dataset in the exact species, regions, and paradigm expected.
justification.handling: Real NWB files streamed via remfile, HD recovered from dual LEDs with -1 sentinel exclusion, rate and spike-count filters explicit and correct alignment; only minor wart is linear interpolation of a circular variable.
justification.analysis: Circular statistics (MVL) with an occupancy-preserving null, effect-size floor, and the paper's correlation-of-correlations with a cell-label permutation null are all present and correct.
justification.correctness: Every headline number reproduces from the committed code and CSV, is internally consistent with the figures, and rests on sound statistics with adequate samples.
justification.figures: Figures are clearly labeled with units and sample sizes and show the effect plainly; example tuning curves are ranked by MVL, the actual effect-strength criterion.
justification.honesty: Claims are proportionate: the write-up explicitly reports the two non-significant sessions and ties them to the fewest HD cells, and reports the mild non-uniformity honestly rather than overstating.
